subject: general
question: At which of the following places was the FIFA Men's World Cup, held in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2018 FIFA World Cup took place between 14 June and 15 July 2018 in Russia.__
 
• It was the 21st edition of the FIFA World Cup.
 
• The final match of the FIFA World Cup 2018 was played between France and Croatia.
 
• France defeated Croatia in the final and claimed their second World Cup.
 
• England's Harry Kane became the top scorer in the tournament with 6 goals and won the Golden Boot Award.
 
• France’s Kylian Mbappe won the Young Player award in the tournament.
 
• The official mascot of the FIFA World Cup 2018 was Zabivaka.
 
• The official song of the tournament was “Live It Up”.
 
• FIFA World Cup 2022 was scheduled to held in Qatar in 2022.
